Hi all —

Thanks for your interest in a short group demo of Redwood Inference. We want to run a compact, single-run demo that suits multiple prospects across regions (we're calling this a "timeband" approach). Goal: one 40–45 minute live session with a focused product walkthrough + 15 minutes for Q&A/breakout.

Please review the suggested timebands below and RSVP with your preferred band. If none work, indicate a strong constraint and we will follow up with a private slot.

Proposed timebands (PT):
- Tue Nov 30 10:00–10:45 PT (morning PT — good for NA morning / EMEA afternoon)
- Wed Dec 1 20:00–20:45 PT (evening PT — friendly for APAC)
- Thu Dec 2 13:00–13:45 PT (midday PT — fallback)

Quick asks:
- Reply with your preferred timeband and list of attendees (name + role).
- RSVP deadline: EOD Monday Nov 29 so we can send calendar invites.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (brief agenda), timeband-rundown.txt (how we'll split the session).

If you'd prefer a dedicated session, let us know and we'll route to a 1:1.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
